important_gaps.gap: They require grandma hands over turtle; sourceS20 starts with child already gripping both turtle rods. Opening0–2.4s is newly proposed real handover, not existing-code evidence.
Old code changes which hand endpoint is used for each turtle attachment. Proposed drawings preserve physical rod identity and produce a visibleX instead.
Old right-facing raw has jade on farL; 2D flip retains arm occlusion and produces wrong near/left reading. New construction uses new anatomical arm chains, not mirrored source pixels.
Old raw shows one short rod; duplicategm grip point cannot prove two real rods in the palm. Proposal requires2distinct shafts/contact bands and pre-cut transfer.
Spin eases out through4.8 although comment/audioactive window ends4.6. Preserve2.4–4.6active action;4.6–4.8only passive settling. No code/audio edit in reference phase.

light_rule: Scene lamp provides incoming light. Master neck orange shading and old card shading are identity references only, not frozen character texture illumination.
